4230
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
of Japanese and other foreign nationals previously placed
under the administration and disposition of the National
Abaca and Other Fibers Corporation, pursuant to the
provisions of Executive Order No. 29, dated November 25,
1946, and Executive Order No. 99, dated October 22, 1947,
which are actually occupied and/or cultivated and developed
by war veterans and other persons at their own expense, ;
are hereby returned to, and placed under, the jurisdiction, *
control and disposition of the Department of Agriculture
and Natural Resources and the Burean of Lands, in ac-
cordance with the provisions of Act No. 3638 and Cormon-
wealth Act No. 141, as amended.
The Bureau of Lands shall cause the lands herein in-
volved to be surveyed to determine the actual occupants
thereof; to require the actual occupants to file sales ap-
plications for their respective holdings, and to pay the
necessary. occupation fees to said Bureau from the time
it takes over the administration thereof, and to take such
other steps as may be necessary in accordance with existing
laws and regulations for the proper administration and
disposition of said lands.
Executive Orders Nos. 29 and 99, dated November 25,
1946, and October 22, 194%, respectively, are hereby
modified accordingly.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of October,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-nine,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the fourth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
